description: Benchmark cases for the assumptions skill. Each case points at a fixture directory and its expected findings file. See rubric.md for grading instructions. `fixture_kind` distinguishes static single-purpose fixtures (fixtures/<id>/, paired with EXPECTED_FINDINGS.md) from the tests/ staged-diff sandbox (a small standalone repo used to test the skill against a live git diff rather than static files; paired with test-notes/EXPECTED.md). Both kinds share the same evals/expected/<id>.json + evals/results/<id>-ledger.md naming convention regardless of which directory the source files live in.

cases.notes: Primary signal is missing idempotency on payment creation.
Two independent P0s: migration fails on existing rows, and worker assumes migration completion.
Checks that the model does not overclaim status about protections it cannot see (middleware, RLS) — the system-wide question should be Unknown, not a confident Protected or Unprotected.

Checks correct evidence-confidence calibration: at-least-once delivery behavior should carry Medium/Low evidence confidence (or an Unknown status), not be asserted as High confidence, unless the queue technology's delivery semantics are confirmed.

A diff that adds ownership verification to a refund endpoint. Tests whether the skill correctly credits the added safeguard while still identifying remaining risks (no idempotency, partial failure window, no test added). Lives at tests/ rather than fixtures/refund-order/ because it is a small standalone repo (own package.json, .claude/skills/, staged git diff) used to test a live skill invocation against real diff mechanics, not a static code sample. The canonical identifier everywhere in this repo (evals/expected/, evals/results/, README.md, evals/BASELINE.md) is `refund-order`; `refund-ownership` and `tests-refund` seen in older evals/results/ filenames are retired aliases, not separate cases.

input_files: DIFF_MANIFEST.md (17 files; only db/003_add_role_column.sql, src/middleware/require-admin.ts, src/routes/admin/delete-org.ts, src/workers/role-sync-worker.ts have real source)
cases.notes: Exercises the >15-file oversized-scope / review-plan branch of SKILL.md step 1, which no other fixture in this suite touches. Tests two things together: (1) whether the review plan correctly selects all four high-risk files and explicitly names what it excluded, not a silent subset; (2) whether a hidden risk that spans two of the selected files (a nullable migration column mishandled differently by an authorization middleware and a background worker) is caught as one connected finding rather than only its first-discovered half. Grading this case requires checking the review plan's selection/exclusion completeness in addition to the normal ledger rubric — see EXPECTED_FINDINGS.md's 'Expected review plan' section.
Tests whether the skill credits explicit provider idempotency key and DB unique constraint safeguards as Protected, rather than fabricating a missing idempotency defect.
Tests whether explicit query tenant predicate is recognized as Protected without falsely claiming a tenant isolation defect.
Tests negative false-positive discipline on a pure synchronous refactor with zero side effects or hidden assumptions.
Tests whether the skill inspects attached validation middleware on the route pipeline before declaring input unvalidated.
